name: Albert Suggitt
role: A retired trawlerman who mends nets on the docks some mornings
temper_why: old trawlerman, mends nets and talks (card)

card.who: A retired trawlerman who mends nets on the quay for the few boats left. He sailed with Mickey Suddaby in the sixties.
card.speak: Slow, salt-dry, says a thing once. Measures time in trips and weather.
card.life: Lives two doors from Ada. Up at five from habit. Nets in the morning, the bench in the afternoon.
card.fire: He smelled paraffin on the wind that night, before the glow.
card.rivals: Fished for Jensen's father. Says the Widow is the only one of the three who ever gutted a fish.
